scene: The freed ribbon dances away, revealing departure docks lined along the crest.
picture: A flat side-scrolling view of the ridge edge. On the far left, a wicker basket rests by a striped hot-air balloon. The boy stands left-centre beside a happy kite girl. In the centre, a red sleigh tram sits on silver rails. At the far right, a glass-bottomed launch rests on a wooden slipway.
shown: a wicker basket tethered to a striped balloon waiting on the left platform
a red wooden sleigh tram stopped on frosty tracks at the centre station
a slipway cradle holding a glass-bottomed boat with its ramp down on the far right
